result.title: ProtoBridge-CLIP: Observation-Masked Finding Prototypes for Medical Image--Report Representation Learning
result.summary: Radiology reports distinguish affirmed findings, explicit negations, and unmentioned concepts, but conventional global image--report contrastive learning often compresses these different evidence states into a single study-level target. We introduce \model{}, which combines symmetric global image--report alignment with observation-masked finding supervision and a soft relation objective over affirmed report concepts. Text-derived finding prototypes are aligned with local visual tokens, while uncertain and unmentioned concepts are excluded from direct finding labels. We evaluate the framework on three CT benchmarks and five chest-radiograph benchmarks, together with component ablations, paired and clinical retrieval, localization, perturbation robustness, calibration, and per-finding analyses. \model{} achieves macro-AUROC values of 73.6%, 66.5\%, and 68.8% on CT-RATE, RAD-ChestCT, and INSPECT, and 80.2%, 91.4%, 78.5%, 86.5%, and 90.8% on ChestXray14, CheXpert, PadChest, RSNA, and SIIM-ACR, respectively. Relative to the matched global-only controls, the findings and relation objectives yield consistent gains across the evaluated datasets. These results demonstrate the practical value of treating observed and unobserved report concepts differently during medical image--text representation learning.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ProtoBridge-CLIP，在对称全局图文对齐之外加入 observation-masked finding 监督与 affirmed 概念的软关系目标，将文本导出的 finding prototype 与局部视觉 token 对齐，并在 3 个 CT 与 5 个胸片基准上做消融、定位与鲁棒性评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文把明确、否定与未提及的报告概念区别对待并排除不确定标签，其原型—局部视觉 token 对齐与证据筛选监督可能为 LVR 中视觉细节保留和 latent 证据选择提供可核查线索；但该工作属医学图文表征学习，非 latent 推理，迁移性待验证。
